_comment: Add these hooks to your ~/.claude/settings.json to integrate with iDashboard
_instructions: 2. Add the 'hooks' section below to your existing settings
3. Restart Claude Code sessions for hooks to take effect
4. Make sure iDashboard is running on port 19280

Notification._description: Fires when Claude Code needs your input (e.g., choose an option, approve a tool use)

Stop._description: Fires when Claude Code finishes responding and the conversation stops
